title: 星瞳·鼓脸晃头

pose-guide.method: 将整张独立星瞳画面按两眼中心做统一旋转、平移和等比缩放，与奶绿同一关键姿势对位。

editing_notes: 逐帧沿用同批明前奶绿《鼓脸晃头》的 54 个曝光时值。星瞳形象取 B 站《揣手手》《老实》，九个动作的位置与奶绿原有姿势图相对照。

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: An exact partner sticker to Nailü’s puffed-cheek side-to-side head shake. One Xingtong in her user-approved design; the reference plate at image stage dictates all hair/clothes/eyes and accessories. Richly detailed chibi portrait with the same close framing as Nailü: tiny fists at the collar, brows gently lowered, cheeks visibly puff, little head turn to one side, hold, swing back, slight opposite settle, tiny o-mouth releases the breath, return. Match the supplied Nailü movement and timing. Preserve her own facial and outfit identity.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Draw one richly detailed chibi Xingtong nearly centered in Nailü’s close portrait framing, tiny fists at her collar, brows gently lowered, cheeks beginning to puff. 2) 0.45 s: Inflate both cheeks fully, seal her lips, and keep her shoulders and collar fists steady. 3) 1.00 s: Turn her puffed face slightly toward screen left, letting her hair and accessories follow naturally. 4) 1.65 s: Hold the small leftward turn with rounded cheeks and a restrained, gently stubborn expression. 5) 2.20 s: Swing her head back through center, keeping her cheeks inflated and her eyes directed toward the viewer. 6) 2.85 s: Settle into a smaller screen-right turn, with a slight delayed sway in her hair and accessories. 7) 3.40 s: Ease back toward center and form a tiny o-mouth as her cheeks begin releasing their air. 8) 3.95 s: Finish the breath with relaxed cheeks and a small o-mouth, keeping both fists visible at her collar. 9) 4.40 s: Close her mouth, begin reinflating her cheeks, and leave her head slightly right of the opening pose for the return.
Continuity: Use the approved plate for all identity details, preserve the fixed crop, visible fists, accessories, props and viewer-directed gaze, and follow Nailü’s supplied motion and timing within a 4.8-second loop whose distinct ninth pose flows into the first. PARTNER EMOTE. The upper reference is the detailed new Xingtong rendering from real Bilibili 揣手手 and 老实. Match that identity exactly in every cell: silver-white rounded bob, one gray curved cowlick, violet headband with tiny white mascot, BLUE eyes with iris detail, pink top, fluffy lavender jacket with cream collar and long puffy cuffs. Warm blush, closely drawn hair sections, soft garment shading. Do not copy the florist character. The lower three-by-three reference supplies ONLY composition and sequential poses: crop head/shoulders similarly at the same relative scale. Exactly ONE silver-haired girl per cell, close-up, both small fists by cheeks. Match these nine LOWER pictures in order: half-lidded deadpan, little fists up, cheeks puff harder, tip markedly to screen RIGHT, settle through center, small counter-rock, let breath out with tiny O mouth, ease fists, return to first expression. Keep nine poses distinct with visible head swing.

Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Match the supplied Nailü movement and timing. Preserve her own facial and outfit identity.

B = 0.45 s: Inflate both cheeks fully, seal her lips, and keep her shoulders and collar fists steady.
C = 1.00 s: Turn her puffed face slightly toward screen left, letting her hair and accessories follow naturally.
